rule:
T1: V6 minus the pairs no other system predicts (not LORA, not V3-noGNN, V4, V3, V2, C2v1, C1), only on S1 that
keep at least one other match (no new empty S1). Leaderboard evidence so far: pairs added to V6 are right ~75-78 % of
the time (breakeven), so the untested direction is removing V6's least-supported pairs.
